products.title: BAT Aluminium Channel Trim (U Channel) – 3m Lengths

seo.title: BAT Aluminium Channel Trim U Channel 3m | ETS Perth
seo.description: BAT aluminium U channel tile trim, 8, 10 and 12mm, 3m lengths. Mill, bright silver, matt silver, matt black or pearl white. Perth.

products.descriptionHtml:
A U-shaped aluminium channel that caps the edge of tile, stone, glass or panels with a clean square finish on both faces. Use it on benchtop and splashback edges, niches, shelves and feature panels.

  • Material: aluminium
  • Length: 3m
  • Sizes (internal width): 8, 10 and 12mm
  • Finishes: Mill Finish, Bright Silver, Matt Silver, Matt Black, Pearl White (coloured finishes come with protective film)

Care: wash finished trims with warm soapy water and a soft cloth. Don't use acid or alkaline cleaners, scourers or sandpaper on coloured, anodised or plated finishes. Remove greasy marks with white spirits, then rinse with clean water.

seo.description: BAT MORTARLOC stainless steel expansion joint for thick-bed mortar tiling. 25mm to 50mm high, 6 or 10mm wide, 1.8m lengths. Perth.

products.descriptionHtml:
MORTARLOC expansion joints are for thick-bed (mortar bed) tiling, where BATEX is for thin-bed adhesive. Two stainless steel side plates hold a neoprene infill, with anchor tabs that lock into the mortar bed. Stainless steel suits commercial kitchens, wet areas and outdoor paving.

  • Material: stainless steel side plates, neoprene infill
  • Length: 1.8m
